# onetsolutions_hosting_redirects (Data Source)

Lists the redirects of a web hosting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_web_hosting" "site" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

data "onetsolutions_hosting_redirects" "site" {
  hosting_id = data.onetsolutions_web_hosting.site.id
}

output "redirects" {
  value = {
    for r in data.onetsolutions_hosting_redirects.site.redirects :
    "${r.domain}${r.source}" => r.destination
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hosting_id` (String) The UUID of the web hosting to read from.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `redirects` (Attributes List) The redirects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--redirects))

<a id="nestedatt--redirects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `redirects`

Read-Only:

- `destination` (String) The URL redirected to.
- `domain` (String) The domain the redirect applies to.
- `source` (String) The path redirected, starting with `/`.
- `type` (String) `301` (permanent) or `302` (temporary).
